[package]
name = "MFEKmath"
version = "0.1.2"
authors = ["Matthew Blanchard <matthewrblanchard@gmail.com>", "Fredrick R. Brennan <copypasteⒶkittens.ph>", "MFEK Authors"]
edition = "2018"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "A library which supplies mathematics and algorithms for manipulating beziers."

[dependencies]
flo_curves = "0.6"
xmltree = "0.10"
plist = "1.3"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.skia-safe]
version = ">0.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.kurbo]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/kurbo.rlib"
branch = "master"

[dependencies.spline]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/spline.rlib"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.glifparser]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/glifparser.rlib"
features = ["glifserde"]
branch = "master"
default-features = false

[dependencies.fontforge-typeconv]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/fontforge-typeconv.rlib"
branch = "main"
default-features = false
optional = true

[features]
default = ["skia-safe", "glifparser/skia", "glifparser/mfek"]
fontforge = ["fontforge-typeconv"]
strict = []
skia = ["skia-safe", "glifparser/skia"]

[package]
name = "chrono_locale"
version = "0.1.1"
authors = ["Alessandro Pellizzari <alex@amiran.it>"]
description = "Localised date and time formatting library for Rust, based on chrono"
homepage = "https://github.com/Alex-PK/chrono-locale"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["date", "time", "calendar"]
categories = ["date-and-time"]
license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/Alex-PK/chrono-locale"
build = "build.rs"

[dependencies]
chrono = "0.4"
lazy_static = "1.2"

[dependencies.num-integer]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[build-dependencies]
serde = "1"
serde_json = "1"
serde_derive = "1"
walkdir = "2"

[package]
name = "ecolor"
version = "0.22.0"
authors = ["Emil Ernerfeldt <emil.ernerfeldt@gmail.com>", "Andreas Reich <reichandreas@gmx.de>"]
description = "Color structs and color conversion utilities"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.65"
homepage = "https://github.com/emilk/egui"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/emilk/egui"
categories = ["mathematics", "encoding"]
keywords = ["gui", "color", "conversion", "gamedev", "images"]
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "**/*.rs", "Cargo.toml"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lib]

[features]
default = []
extra_debug_asserts = []
extra_asserts = []

[dependencies.bytemuck]
version = "1.7.2"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.cint]
version = "0.3.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.color-hex]
version = "0.2.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.document-features]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "egui"
version = "0.22.0"
authors = ["Emil Ernerfeldt <emil.ernerfeldt@gmail.com>"]
description = "An easy-to-use immediate mode GUI that runs on both web and native"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.65"
homepage = "https://github.com/emilk/egui"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "../../README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/emilk/egui"
categories = ["gui", "game-development"]
keywords = ["gui", "imgui", "immediate", "portable", "gamedev"]
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "**/*.rs", "Cargo.toml"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lib]

[features]
default = ["default_fonts"]
bytemuck = ["epaint/bytemuck"]
cint = ["epaint/cint"]
color-hex = ["epaint/color-hex"]
deadlock_detection = ["epaint/deadlock_detection"]
default_fonts = ["epaint/default_fonts"]
extra_debug_asserts = ["epaint/extra_debug_asserts"]
extra_asserts = ["epaint/extra_asserts"]
log = ["dep:log", "epaint/log"]
mint = ["epaint/mint"]
persistence = ["serde", "epaint/serde", "ron"]
serde = ["dep:serde", "epaint/serde", "accesskit?/serde"]
unity = ["epaint/unity"]

[dependencies]
nohash-hasher = "0.2"

[dependencies.epaint]
version = "0.22.0"
path = "../epaint"
default-features = false

[dependencies.ahash]
version = "0.8.1"
default-features = false
features = ["no-rng", "std"]

[dependencies.accesskit]
version = "0.11"
optional = true

[dependencies.document-features]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.log]
version = "0.4"
optional = true
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.ron]
version = "0.8"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[package]
name = "egui-sdl2-event"
authors = ["Valtteri Vallius"]
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["sdl2", "egui"]
categories = ["gui", "input"]
description = "Provides event handling for egui in SDL2 window applications."
license = "MIT"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/kaphula/egui-sdl2-event"
homepage = "https://github.com/kaphula/egui-sdl2-event"

[dependencies]
sdl2 = "0.35.2"

[dependencies.egui]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/egui.rlib"

[package]
name = "egui_skia"
version = "0.3.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "egui_skia is a skia integration for the egui ui library. Render egui within a skia application or render skia in a egui application."
license = "MIT"
homepage = "https://github.com/lucasmerlin/egui_skia"
repository = "https://github.com/lucasmerlin/egui_skia"
keywords = ["skia", "egui", "skia-safe", "gui"]
categories = ["gui"]

[features]
winit = ["dep:egui-winit"]
cpu_fix = []
vulkan = ["skia-safe/vulkan", "skulpin"]
metal = ["skia-safe/metal"]

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 3

[dependencies]
egui_demo_lib = "=0.21.0"
raw-window-handle = "0.5"
foreign-types-shared = "0.1.1"
gl = "0.14.0"

[dependencies.egui]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/egui.rlib"

[dependencies.skia-safe]
version = ">= 0.54"
features = ["gl"]

[dependencies.egui-winit]
version = ">=0.20"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.skulpin]
version = ">=0.14.1"
features = []
optional = true

[dependencies.softbuffer]
git = "https://github.com/john01dav/softbuffer"

[dependencies.sdl2]
version = "0.35.2"
features = ["raw-window-handle"]

[dependencies.egui-sdl2-event]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/egui-sdl2-event.rlib"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dev-dependencies]
metal = "0.24"
cocoa = "0.24"
core-graphics-types = "0.1"
objc = "0.2"

[package]
name = "emath"
version = "0.22.0"
authors = ["Emil Ernerfeldt <emil.ernerfeldt@gmail.com>"]
description = "Minimal 2D math library for GUI work"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.65"
homepage = "https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/master/crates/emath"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/master/crates/emath"
categories = ["mathematics", "gui"]
keywords = ["math", "gui"]
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "**/*.rs", "Cargo.toml"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lib]

[features]
default = []
extra_debug_asserts = []
extra_asserts = []

[dependencies.bytemuck]
version = "1.7.2"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.document-features]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.mint]
version = "0.5.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "epaint"
version = "0.22.0"
authors = ["Emil Ernerfeldt <emil.ernerfeldt@gmail.com>"]
description = "Minimal 2D graphics library for GUI work"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.65"
homepage = "https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/master/crates/epaint"
license = "(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND OFL-1.1 AND LicenseRef-UFL-1.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/master/crates/epaint"
categories = ["graphics", "gui"]
keywords = ["graphics", "gui", "egui"]
include = ["../LICENSE-APACHE", "../LICENSE-MIT", "**/*.rs", "Cargo.toml", "fonts/*.ttf", "fonts/*.txt", "fonts/OFL.txt", "fonts/UFL.txt"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lib]

[features]
default = ["default_fonts"]
bytemuck = ["dep:bytemuck", "emath/bytemuck", "ecolor/bytemuck"]
cint = ["ecolor/cint"]
color-hex = ["ecolor/color-hex"]
deadlock_detection = ["dep:backtrace"]
default_fonts = []
extra_debug_asserts = ["emath/extra_debug_asserts", "ecolor/extra_debug_asserts"]
extra_asserts = ["emath/extra_asserts", "ecolor/extra_asserts"]
log = ["dep:log"]
mint = ["emath/mint"]
serde = ["dep:serde", "ahash/serde", "emath/serde", "ecolor/serde"]
unity = []

[dependencies]
ab_glyph = "0.2.11"
nohash-hasher = "0.2"

[dependencies.emath]
version = "0.22.0"
path = "../emath"

[dependencies.ecolor]
version = "0.22.0"
path = "../ecolor"

[dependencies.ahash]
version = "0.8.1"
default-features = false
features = ["no-rng", "std"]

[dependencies.bytemuck]
version = "1.7.2"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.document-features]
version = "0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.log]
version = "0.4"
optional = true
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
parking_lot = "0.12"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.backtrace]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies]
atomic_refcell = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.4"
default-features = false

[[bench]]
name = "benchmark"
harness = false

[package]
name = "glifparser"
version = "2.0.1"
authors = ["Fredrick Brennan <copypaste@kittens.ph>", "MFEK Authors"]
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0"
keywords = ["glif", "parsers", "ufo-format", "fonts"]
description = "A parser and writer for UFO `.glif` files"
repository = "https://github.com/MFEK/glifparser.rlib"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["fat-no-skia"]

[dependencies]
derive_more = "0.99"
derivative = "2.2"
log = "0.4"
trees = "0.4"
plist = "1.3"
itertools = "0.10"
float-cmp = "0.9"
dyn-clone = "1.0.9"
spline = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.xmltree]
version = "0.10"
features = ["attribute-order"]

[dependencies.kurbo]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/kurbo.rlib"
branch = "master"

[dependencies.skia-safe]
version = ">0.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.24"
features = ["png"]
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.flo_curves]
version = "0.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.integer_or_float]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["hash", "float-cmp", "more-serde", "faster-strconv"]

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.9"
test-log = "0.2"
lazy_static = "1"

[features]
glifimage = ["image"]
glifserde = ["serde", "kurbo/serde", "integer_or_float/serde", "plist/default"]
default = ["glifimage", "glifserde"]
skia = ["default", "skia-safe"]
mfek = ["default"]
more-image-formats = ["image/gif", "image/jpeg", "image/webp", "image/bmp", "image/tiff"]
more-iof = ["integer_or_float/num-traits"]
fat = ["glifimage", "glifserde", "skia", "mfek", "more-image-formats", "more-iof"]
fat-no-skia = ["glifimage", "glifserde", "mfek", "more-image-formats", "more-iof"]

[package]
name = "glifrenderer"
version = "0.1.2"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
skia-safe = ">=0.54.0"
log = "0.4"
font-kit = "0.10"
derive_more = "0.99"
enum-unitary = "0.4.3"
enum-iterator = "0.7.0"
lazy_static = "1.4"
kurbo = "0.8"
flo_curves = "0.6"
num-traits = "0.2"

[dependencies.glifparser]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/glifparser.rlib"
branch = "master"
features = ["mfek", "skia"]

[dependencies.MFEKmath]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/math.rlib"
branch = "main"
features = ["skia"]

[package]
name = "kurbo"
version = "0.9.5"
authors = ["Raph Levien <raph.levien@gmail.com>"]
license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["graphics", "curve", "curves", "bezier", "geometry"]
repository = "https://github.com/linebender/kurbo"
description = "A 2D curves library"
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["graphics"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
features = ["mint", "schemars", "serde"]

[features]
default = ["std"]
std = []

[dependencies]
smallvec = "1.10"

[dependencies.arrayvec]
version = "0.7.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.libm]
version = "0.2.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.mint]
version = "0.5.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "0.8.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.105"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["alloc", "derive"]

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.8.0"

[target."cfg(target_arch=\"wasm32\")".dev-dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.2.0"
features = ["js"]

[package]
name = "mfek-ipc"
version = "0.0.4-beta1"
authors = ["Fredrick Brennan <copypaste@kittens.ph>"]
description = "Modular Font Editor K (MFEK) inter-process communication library."
edition = "2018"
license = "Apache-2.0"
keywords = ["mfek-ipc"]
repository = "https://github.com/MFEK/ipc.rlib"

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
notify = "5"
serde_json = "1.0"
serde = "1.0"
figlet-rs = "0.1"
colored = "2"
atty = "0.2"
chrono = "0.4"

[dependencies.glifparser]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/glifparser.rlib"
branch = "master"

[dependencies.chrono_locale]
version = "0.1"
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/chrono-locale.rlib"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
ansi_term = "0.12"

[dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.10"
test-log = "0.2"

[features]
reproducible-build = []

[package]
name = "nfd"
version = "0.0.4"
authors = ["Saurav Sachidanand <sauravsachidanand@gmail.com>", "Daniel Collin <daniel@collin.com>", "Denis Kolodin <deniskolodin@gmail.com>"]
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://www.github.com/saurvs/nfd-rs"
description = "Rust bindings to nativefiledialog"
keywords = ["file", "dialog", "ui"]
build = "build.rs"

[build-dependencies]
cc = "1.0.79"

[package]
name = "pathfinder_simd"
version = "0.5.6"
edition = "2018"
authors = ["Patrick Walton <pcwalton@mimiga.net>"]
build = "build.rs"
description = "A simple SIMD library"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/servo/pathfinder"
homepage = "https://github.com/servo/pathfinder"

[features]
pf-no-simd = []

[dependencies]

[build-dependencies]
rustc_version = "0.4"

[package]
name = "pub-mod"
version = "0.1.1"
authors = ["Fredrick Brennan <copypaste@kittens.ph>"]
edition = "2018"

[dependencies]
syn = "1.0"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[package]
name = "softbuffer"
version = "0.4.8"
edition = "2021"
description = "Cross-platform buffer for software rendering"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/softbuffer"
repository = "https://github.com/rust-windowing/softbuffer"
rust-version = "1.71.0"
keywords = ["framebuffer", "windowing"]
categories = ["game-development", "graphics", "gui", "multimedia", "rendering"]
exclude = ["examples"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "wasm32-unknown-unknown"]

[features]
default = ["wayland", "wayland-dlopen", "x11", "x11-dlopen"]
wayland = ["dep:wayland-backend", "dep:wayland-client", "dep:wayland-sys", "dep:memmap2", "dep:rustix", "dep:fastrand", "winit/wayland", "winit/wayland-csd-adwaita"]
wayland-dlopen = ["wayland-sys/dlopen", "winit/wayland-dlopen"]
x11 = ["dep:as-raw-xcb-connection", "dep:fastrand", "dep:rustix", "dep:tiny-xlib", "dep:x11rb", "winit/x11"]
x11-dlopen = ["tiny-xlib/dlopen", "x11rb/dl-libxcb"]
kms = ["dep:drm", "dep:rustix"]

[dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6"
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
ndk = "0.9.0"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dev-dependencies]
android-activity = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dev-dependencies.winit]
version = "0.30.0"
features = ["android-native-activity"]

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.fastrand]
version = "2.0.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.rustix]
version = "1.0.1"
default-features = false
optional = true
features = ["fs", "mm", "shm", "std"]

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.memmap2]
version = "0.9.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.wayland-backend]
version = "0.3.0"
optional = true
features = ["client_system"]

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.wayland-client]
version = "0.31.14"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.wayland-sys]
version = "0.31.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.as-raw-xcb-connection]
version = "1.0.0"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.tiny-xlib]
version = "0.2.1"
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.x11rb]
version = "0.13.0"
optional = true
features = ["allow-unsafe-code", "shm"]

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dependencies.drm]
version = "0.15.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[target."cfg(not(any(target_os = \"android\", target_vendor = \"apple\", target_os = \"redox\", target_family = \"wasm\", target_os = \"windows\")))".dev-dependencies.rustix]
version = "1.0.1"
features = ["event"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.61.2"
features = ["Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_UI_ColorSystem", "Win32_UI_Shell", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_Foundation"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6.0"
libc = "0.2.180"

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-core-graphics]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "objc2", "libc", "CGColorSpace", "CGDataProvider", "CGImage"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-core-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "CFCGTypes"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "objc2-core-foundation", "NSDictionary", "NSGeometry", "NSKeyValueObserving", "NSString", "NSThread", "NSValue", "NSNull"]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies.objc2-quartz-core]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "objc2-core-foundation", "CALayer", "CATransaction"]

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.63"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.108"

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dependencies.web-sys]
version = "0.3.55"
features = ["CanvasRenderingContext2d", "Document", "Element", "HtmlCanvasElement", "ImageData", "OffscreenCanvas", "OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2d", "Window"]

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "0.3"
console_error_panic_hook = "0.1"
tracing-web = "0.1"

[target."cfg(target_family = \"wasm\")".dev-dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["wasm_js"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"redox\")".dependencies]
libredox = "0.1.18"

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies]
rayon = "1.5.1"

[target."cfg(not(target_family = \"wasm\"))".dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.8.1"
default-features = false
features = ["cargo_bench_support"]

[[example]]
name = "winit_android"
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[[example]]
name = "winit_multithread_android"
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[[bench]]
name = "buffer"
harness = false

[dev-dependencies]
colorous = "1.0.12"
web-time = "1.0.0"
glam = "0.33.0"
rand = "0.10.0"

[dev-dependencies.winit]
version = "0.30.0"
default-features = false
features = ["rwh_06"]

[dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.18"
features = ["env-filter"]

[dev-dependencies.image]
version = "0.25.0"
default-features = false
features = ["jpeg"]

[package]
name = "spline"
version = "0.3.0"
license = "MIT/Apache-2.0"
authors = ["Raph Levien <raph.levien@gmail.com>"]
edition = "2018"
keywords = ["graphics", "curve", "curves", "bezier", "spline"]
repository = "https://github.com/linebender/spline"
description = "A spline for interactive 2D curve design"
readme = "README.md"
categories = ["graphics"]

[dependencies.kurbo]
git = "https://github.com/MFEK/kurbo.rlib"
branch = "master"

[dependencies.serde_]
version = "1.0.117"
package = "serde"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.7"
serde_json = "1.0.59"

[features]
serde = ["serde_", "kurbo/serde"]

[[example]]
name = "json"
required-features = ["serde"]
